name: Other (not listed)
description: Any agent that is not in this list. Guided install; with a confirmed config path the engine can still write a standard mcpServers entry.

mcp.notes: Look up the agent's documentation, confirm the config file with the user, then pass --config-path <file>. Only the common {"mcpServers": {...}} layout is written automatically.

skill.notes: Find the agent's skills folder, confirm it with the user, then pass --skills-dir <folder>.
